rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or thing that is amusingly quirky and unconventional.

example.english: Your son is really zany; he is always coming up with odd ideas.
example.traditional: 你個仔真係古靈精怪，成日諗埋啲古怪橋。
example.jyutping: nei5 go3 zai2 zan1 hai6 gu2 ling4 zing1 gwaai3 seng4 jat6 nam2 maai4 di1 gu2 gwaai3 kiu4

rows.note: Choose this when the emphasis is on an odd, eccentric, or outlandish appearance or manner.

example.english: He looks so zany dressed like that today that everyone stares at him when he goes out.
example.traditional: 佢今日着到咁騎呢，行出街個個都望住佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek6 dou3 gam3 ke4 le4 haang4 ceot1 gaai1 go3 go3 dou1 mong6 zyu6 keoi5

rows.note: Choose this when the emphasis is on being funny or clownish rather than simply strange.

example.english: As soon as Ming got on stage, he got zany and the whole audience could not stop laughing.
example.traditional: 阿明一上台就搞笑，成班觀眾笑到停唔到。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 jat1 soeng5 toi1 zau6 gaau2 siu3 sing4 baan1 gun1 zung3 siu3 dou3 ting4 m4 dou3
